nom: Avène Cicalfate+ Hydrating Skin Recovery Emulsion

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, extremely reactive skin reports fewer breakouts and less reactivity after months of use, and another with an oily T-zone (combination) reports it helps chin breakouts without adding shine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin and dry cheeks report it softens and moisturizes, though one reviewer testing it purely as a face cream found it dried her skin out more than expected.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (dry cheeks, oily T-zone) report it balances both areas and helps chin breakouts while easing dry patches.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often report soothing and redness relief, but this is also the segment with the most reports of stinging, allergic swelling, peeling, and reactions, including under tretinoin.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as feeding shiny, sun-damaged skin and healing dermatitis, and another with post-procedure (Fraxel) skin reports fast absorption and soothing with no greasiness.

concerns.aging: One reviewer applies it over hyaluronic acid serum and reports waking with smoother, softer skin; another describes it as helping sun-damaged skin, but aging is not a primary focus of most reviews.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers call it noticeably hydrating and lightweight, layering it over serums or under sunscreen; one dissenting reviewer found it dried her skin out rather than moisturizing.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report immediate or fast calming, including for rosacea and pimple-related redness; a minority report the opposite, with the product doing nothing for their redness or worsening it into swollen, red, peeling skin.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe it as protecting and helping the skin barrier and calling the line good for barrier issues; some barrier-compromised users instead report stinging or major irritation from the reformulation.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report it heals sores, scrapes, sunburn, tattoos, and post-bandaid irritation, and one used it successfully on perioral dermatitis flare-ups.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts or full resolution of hormonal/pre-period breakouts within days; one dissenting reviewer describes ongoing chin breakouts unaffected and another reports outright irritation instead of improvement.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with an oily T-zone reports the product controls that area without heaviness, and another notes it feels moisturizing without greasy feel despite oily, reactive skin.

aspects.libelle: Stinging or allergic reaction on application
High price for small tube size

Finally, this emulsion works well for me!
